description:
Return the connected FateTell account: masked email, sign-in method, interface language, time zone, membership status, the permissions granted to this client, and this account's remaining quota for each tool.
Use when the user asks which account is connected, whether membership is active, how many calls remain, or when a tool returned membership_required or rate_limited.
Not for reading charts (use list_saved_charts / get_saved_chart).
Read-only.
name: get_fatetell_account

email_masked.description: First character, *** and the domain; null when the account has no email.

login_method.description: Sign-in method, e.g. email, google or apple.

timezone.description: IANA time zone of the account.

client_name.description: Name of the connected client when known.

granted_at.description: When access was granted, when known.

engine_version.description: FateTell calculation engine version (package version + commit).

links.description: FateTell web pages for objects in this result, for citation. Only objects already present in the result are linked.

rel.description: Which FateTell page this is: chart, daily_fortune, luck_pillars or account.

url.description: Page in the FateTell web app for an object that appears in this result.

is_member.description: True when a membership is active on any platform.

platform.description: web, ios or android; null when not a member.

tier.description: yearly, monthly or weekly; null when not a member.

notes.description: Codes for facts that qualify this result: hour_assumed (no birth time, 12:00 used), true_solar_skipped_no_longitude, southern_month_adjusted, palace_formula_lunar_javascript (life and body palaces follow the lunar-javascript formula), legacy_v0_chart, judgment_unavailable, chart_pending, truncated, lunar_converted (the birth date was given in the lunar calendar and converted to Gregorian).

quotas.description: This account's per-tool limits; tools without a limit are not listed.

reset_at.description: When the window resets, ISO 8601 UTC.

window.description: Counting window; days are UTC calendar days.

title: Get FateTell account
